messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — NOVUS (enterprise/vpc) gateway reports elevated websocket streaming errors and client retries. Error spike started ~2149998800. Affected: dedicated pool 'novus-prod-pool', tenant isolation flag true. Paging on-call: @Maya Patel. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/vpc-gw-streaming

Maya Patel: taking pager. joining. can someone paste top error?

Sam Liu: pasting recent gateway errors from logs: ```
2026-03-14T21:34:12Z novus-gw-03 stream_handshake_failed conn_id=0x8a2 err=timeout
2026-03-14T21:34:12Z novus-gw-02 stream_write Err=broken_pipe client_retry=3
2026-03-14T21:34:13Z novus-router rate_limiter_drop route=/v1/stream reason=burst
```

Jin Park: seeing a pattern — TO=timeout during initial ws handshake and then client retries -> connection churn. Also an uptick in backend 503s from the dedicated pool: `502 Bad Gateway` from novus-backend-asg.

Maya Patel: severity confirm? customer impact?

Rajesh Kapoor: Novus reported multiple service degradation alerts from their side. Their app sees ~30% of streaming sessions fail to upgrade to ws, and clients are aggressively retrying (backoff not applied). They are on Dedicated (reserved) with soft tenant isolation; traffic is hitting novus-prod-pool.

Maya Patel: quick mitigation options: 1) scale pool up, 2) enable ws->polling fallback at gateway, 3) apply short-term client-facing throttle/429 to force backoff, 4) route to fallback region. Which can we do fast?

Sam Liu: I can scale the dedicated pool by adding 2 nodes (GPU instances) now. ETA ~4m to register. Command: `infractl pool scale --pool novus-prod-pool --add 2`

Jin Park: on gateway side we can flip `ws.enable_handshake_timeout_extended=false` to lengthen timeout? actually current global handshake_timeout is 2s, maybe too low for their client network. We can bump to 6s per-route. Patch command (hot reload): ```kubectl -n infra patch configmap gw-config -p '{"data":{"novus_handshake_timeout":"6s"}}'```

ops-bot: Action logged: scaling request by Sam Liu (job 67241). Estimated completion: 4m.

Maya Patel: Sam, do scale. Jin, do the gateway patch as hotfix. Rajesh, please open a short customer-facing blurb and ask Novus to implement exponential backoff client-side.

Rajesh Kapoor: drafting message: "We're investigating streaming failures affecting websocket upgrades. We've scaled your dedicated pool and adjusted gateway handshake timeout to reduce timeouts; please apply exponential backoff on client retries. We'll follow up with telemetry. — Rajesh" Send?

Maya Patel: send. Also set internal incident severity P1 and start a timeline. I'll take command. Sam update when pool nodes are healthy.

Sam Liu: scaled, new instances registering. kube events show pods coming up. ETA ~3m.

incident-bot: Auto-note: On-call handoff status: Maya Patel acknowledged pager at 2149998892.

Jin Park: gateway patch applied, rolling restart of gw infra started. Command used: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gw-deployment -n infra` — patch applied only to novus route via configmap key. Monitoring for 30s.

Sam Liu: pool nodes ready. Backend 503 rate dropped ~60% in the last 90s. Metrics: active_handshakes success rate up from 68% -> 89%.

Maya Patel: good. I'm going to enable a temporary rate-limit rule to force client exponential backoff for excessive retries: ```api: 
  rate_limit:
    - id: novus-client-retries
      match: path_prefix:
        - /v1/stream
      limit: 10/minute
      response_code: 429
``` Applying.

ops-bot: Rule applied by Maya Patel (change-id 8992).

Rajesh Kapoor: Novus replied: "Thanks — we've patched our client to increase backoff and saw immediate reduction in retries. Could you confirm if you made any code-level changes?"

Maya Patel: replied to customer: "We scaled your dedicated pool and adjusted gateway handshake timeout and rate-limits to mitigate retry storms. No model or code changes to your containers. We're monitoring; please share any client metrics you can."

Sam Liu: telemetry shows streaming error-rate down to 4% (from 28%). Connection churn reduced. Still watching for regressions.

Jin Park: suggest a post-incident config: increase per-route default handshake_timeout to 5s for customers in regions with high WAN jitter, and add a rate-limit small-burst auto-mitigation for tenant-isolated pools. I'll file infra task.

Maya Patel: agreed. Also capture a shortstop: follow up with Novus account team to coordinate a scheduled client rollback window if issues persist. Rajesh?

Rajesh Kapoor: noted, will follow up in 30m.

Maya Patel: closing immediate mitigation. Will keep incident thread open for 2 hours for monitoring. If error rate stays <5% and SLA metrics stable, we'll transition to postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Pager cleared at 2149999412.
